description: Bus, timetable, weather and traffic data for bus bunching prediction is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Borges Veruska Santos (UFCG). Integrated data corresponding to information about bus travel, timetables, weather and traffic data from city of Curitiba, Brazil. This data was downloaded manually from the API or by automatic scraping, using JavaScript. They were integrated by day and grouped by month considering the BULMA approach, using Java and Spark technologies. Coverage: national (BR); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
